Rae (CSM): Kickoff for AuroraQ QBR prep 1. Need account health bullet, onboarding blockers, token econ snapshot, and a one-slide cost ops plan. Meeting Mon 11am PT. Who owns the cost slide?

Corey (FinOps): I can take cost. Will produce: 90d trend + 30d spike table + 8-week forecast (conservative/likely/optimistic). Any known heavy jobs?

Mina (Solutions): Yes  they run a nightly vector-pipeline at 02:30 UTC that peaks tokens. I have the pipeline manifest and a simple cache middleware we can propose.

Jules (Sales): Renewal window 2026-09-18. CFO flagged "wild daily spend" as main risk. They'll want a clear near-term mitigation and reserved quote.

report-bot: export: auroraq_spend_1745556667.csv uploaded to s3://exports/auroraq/1745556667.csv

Corey (FinOps): Uploaded (drive): https://files.redwood/auroraq/1745556667/forecast_summary.png. Key insight: two nightly runs caused 45% of last month's spike. Proposed mitigations: set embed cache ttl=7d, quantize batch model to int8, add daily spend alert at 75%.

Mina (Solutions): Snippet for cache middleware to show in deck:
```
# python cache example
if req.type == 'embed':
  key = sha256(req.payload)
  if cache.exists(key):
    return cache.get(key)
  out = call_embed(req)
  cache.set(key, out, ttl=604800)  # 7d
  return out
```
Will run staging before/after and post perf numbers.

Rae (CSM): Owners & deadlines: Corey = cost + charts by Fri 3pm; Mina = demo + perf numbers by Mon 9am; Jules = asks + reserved quote draft by Fri EOD. Dry run Mon 10:15.

Jules (Sales): Also confirm: can we show per-route per-key cost in Console for their API key? CFO requested screenshot.

Mina (Solutions): Yes, console supports per-key breakdown now. I'll grab a blurred screenshot and attach.

Corey (FinOps): I'll include a Hosted vs Dedicated delta table and a short note: Dedicated can reduce unit cost at scale but may need local cache connectors if they go private.

Rae (CSM): Great. I'll compile onboarding feedback: common flags = "no starter configs", "unclear batch defaults". Proposal: ship a Starter Kit with recommended batching/cache/quota guardrails.

report-bot: ticket AU-482 updated: starter-kit checklist added

Rae (CSM): Thanks team 44d I'll check in Fri morning for final assets.
